items.image_alt: Jess and Shaz stand arm in arm in front of a royal blue curtain, each raising a fist and smiling. Jess, on the left, has dark hair pulled back and wears large red and black glasses. Her white singlet carries a round badge reading “Intersectional Bogan Weirdo Feminist Melbourne” with a women’s symbol. Shaz rests her head against Jess’s and wears a patterned hijab, gold fan earrings and a black long sleeve top.
items.caption: We posed for this photo last week, and were saddened to hear of Gloria Steinem’s passing just days later.
